recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition split between a warm, fiery sunset sky and a cold, frosted winter forest, intersected by a prominent black-and-white checkerboard grid that creates a digital-analog glitch effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between warm orange sky and cool blue-white snow
Geometric rigidity of the grid versus organic chaos of the trees
Text placement within the negative space of the upper horizon

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The landscape is divided horizontally; the upper third features the sky and text, while the lower two-thirds are dominated by the forest and grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central checkerboard band that transitions the two environments.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves across the sunset, and descends through the grid into the detailed forest floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The open orange sky provides the primary area for typographic clarity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the upper half, low saturation/high value in the lower half.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all elements to maintain a utilitarian, lo-fi aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic typewriter feel with clean legibility.
Provides a slightly more organic, ink-on-paper look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a landscape collage. The top half is a dramatic orange and dark grey sunset over distant hills. The bottom half is a dense, frosted winter forest in white and blue tones. Overlay a black and white checkerboard grid across the middle section, fading into the forest.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase monospaced slab-serif text in the upper left quadrant within the orange sky area. Ensure wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon split between warm and cold colors?
Is the checkerboard pattern present and sharp?
Is the text lowercase and monospaced?
Is there a visible film grain or lo-fi texture?

adjustableVariables: Amount of frost on the trees
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or URLs in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Verify the grid does not obscure the text.
Ensure the transition between sky and forest feels like a deliberate collage edge.
Check that the text remains legible against the orange background.
Confirm the absence of any modern logos or watermarks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Landscape A: Warm/Sky] with [Landscape B: Cold/Forest] using [Geometric Pattern: Checkerboard] as a transitional mask, topped with [Typography: Monospaced Slab Serif] for a lo-fi alternative aesthetic.
